name: אַכַּד
summary: Akkad is a city in the land of Shinar, one of the places that formed the beginning of Nimrod’s kingdom. The text gives no derivation of the name.

evidence.note: Akkad is named between Erech and Calneh, and the list ends with the words “in the land of Shinar.”

note: Moved from the former word entry `2akkad` (old root key אכד). TIPNR spells the record Accad.
